metadata.title: Palantir's stock gains again as software sector reaps benefit of rotation trade - MarketWatch

content.text:
15 hours ago
Palantir's stock gains again as software sector reaps benefit of rotation trade
In another sign that the rotation trade is alive and well, once-beaten-down shares of Palantir Technologies, and the software sector in general, were extending win streaks, while the once-hot chip sector continued dropping.
Palantir's stock was surging 3.4% in recent trading and has soared 27.8% amid a seven-session win streak, the longest such streak since the seven-day stretch that ended April. 30, 2025, according to Dow Jones Market Data. The iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF, of which Palantir's stock is a component, was up 0.9% and also headed for a seventh straight gain.
Despite the gains, Palantir's stock was still down 22.9% in 2026, while the IGV ETF was down 9.5%. From 2023 through 2025, Palantir's stock had rocketed 2,665% and the IGV had soared 106.5%.
